title: TWRP C3B2 Procurement Package Plan Dashboard — Knowledge Base
description: Machine-readable blueprint of the PPP dashboard: a self-contained offline HTML page that reads the Procurement Package Plan workbook and renders procurement status, plan coverage, look-ahead and validation views.

project_metadata.name: TWRP C3B2 — Procurement Package Plan Interactive Dashboard
project_metadata.description: Single-file, offline procurement dashboard driven entirely by the Code sheet contract inside the source workbook.
project_metadata.purpose: Show package scope, procurement stage coverage, PO issuance trend, look-ahead work, overdue packages, and data-quality findings from one Procurement Package Plan workbook.

architecture_overview.status: Modular pipeline (P1-P4, 2026-10-30): src/xlsx-reader.mjs (S0/S1), src/pipeline.mjs (contract, S2, S3, stage helpers, isExcelError/isAbsent) and src/render.mjs (S4 deriveView, paint-only S5, CSV row builders, boot). deriveView(model, STATE) is the only aggregation step. Blank and formula-error cells are absent at S2; S3 emits a fatal W-FORMULA per affected column. build.mjs inlines the modules into the single offline Procurement-Dashboard.html. Five test layers (units, imports, edges, build, panels) and a harness Tier 3 adapter verify it: 236 assertions; harness Tiers 1-4 pass (one advisory). P8.6 is complete (workplan 8.15): the search panel carries an attached column picker and the query is scoped to the chosen column. P8.5 is complete (workplan 8.14): the category filter and search controls follow spec 7.1 B1/A5. P8.4 is complete (workplan 8.13): the layout reflows on any width change (panels shrink, the PO chart follows its host, split tables re-sync) and navigation stays reachable below 820 px. P8.3 is complete (workplan 8.12): stacked panels are separated by a 14 px content-column gap (spec 4, assertion 19). P8.2 is complete (workplan 8.11): the notice area is pinned below the menu bar and outside the scrolling body (spec 3.5, assertion 18). P8.1 is complete (workplan 8.10): per-month bands fix the stale PO hover window and a dashed snap line follows the hovered month. P8 is complete (workplan 8.9): chart and KPI hover detail with keyboard and touch, four-page routing, full validation list with fixed-size severity icons, component polish and contrast enforced hard. 263 assertions; Tiers 1-4 pass with no advisories. Documentation (Rev 1.49): the workplan was restructured (Document ID, scope summary, file reference, decision register), all issues moved to the canonical log, and general UI rules left to the spec. Pipeline status: CONFORMING to spec §3.8 (P5 close-out). P6.1 (2026-10-30): shared spec shell in place (title bar, menu bar, nav sidebar, content zones, status bar); search is an S4 filter. P6.2 (2026-11-01): panels 1-7 conform to spec 4-4.5 - title row with Help/Collapse and a DOM-order number, .c-card chart surfaces, split headers with row counts and CSV, drill accordion with a real button, validation count strip / Rules table / Columns toggle. P6.3 (2026-11-01): KPI cards conform to spec 5 (72 px, two lines, status-class strip), component colour literals are tokens, and the CSV actions use the canonical .btn-secondary with data-act. P6.4 (2026-11-01): five themes (light, dark, sky, ocean, presentation) are token-only remaps with a Settings picker and persistence; workplan 8.9 holds the conformance record with 17 spec 8.2 assertions. P7 (2026-11-01) implemented the spec 7.2.15 split-header contract (one .splitcard container, .vheadwrap header port, --ds-sbw gutter, body-derived column widths, ResizeObserver lock-step) through one syncSplitTable() helper, and closed deviations D15-D18; Tier 4 now passes 85/0.

modules.name: Validation engine
modules.status: Complete; validate() runs V-01 to V-26 and tags every issue as error, warning or info, and returns W-FORMULA warnings from the S2 token counts. STAGES and the stage date helpers live here (P2).

modules.status: Complete; deriveView(model, STATE) is the single S4 aggregation step. Renderers paint the derived view only; DOM wiring is in boot(). S3/S4/S5 have their own boundaries. W-FORMULA reaches #errBanner as a fatal strip and never blocks the load.

modules.name: Pipeline test harness
modules.status: Complete; test/test_pipeline.mjs imports src/ (71 assertions). test_units (37), test_edges (22), test_build (19) and test_panels (63) add the other layers. harness-layout checks/ppp.mjs supplies Tier 3 ground truth.

data_flows: Code sheet grid -> contract (fields, columns, types, lookups, error wording)
model + STATE -> validate -> report -> panels, banner and CSV
model + filter state -> derived views (KPIs, charts, tables, drill-down)
integration_points: Procurement Package Plan workbook (TWRP C3B2 - Procurement Package Plan.xlsx)
Browser localStorage for theme and layout preferences
Shared UI standards in Dashboard-UI-Design-Spec.md and AGENTS.md

core_entities: Package — one procurement package row in the PPP sheet, keyed by Package No. or Package Title
Stage — MR, PO, VD, FAT and ROS, each with Plan, Forecast and Actual dates
Lookup — Discipline, Criticality, Package Status and Item Category code/description pairs
Validation issue — one finding with severity, rule code, package, field, value and message
Code sheet contract — the metadata rows and field mappings that define every other rule
relationships: One Code sheet defines the contract for one PPP sheet
Each package belongs to one discipline, one criticality and one status
A stage date pair (Plan vs Actual) drives coverage, overdue and look-ahead logic
Every validation issue may cite one package and one field; aggregate issues cite no package
terminology: Look-ahead — POs planned inside the selected horizon (1m to 6m, default 3m)

key_schemas.name: Code sheet contract
key_schemas.status: Active; the runtime contract. Group 1 rows 2-41 define metadata and field-to-column mappings.
key_schemas.description: Rows 1-9 hold metadata (title, code, client, consultant, dashboard title, start date, header row, list end row); rows 10-41 map each field label to a Column-X letter and a data type. Lookup blocks and the error table are located by row-1 header text.

key_schemas.name: Knowledge base schema
key_schemas.status: Active; shared repository schema that this file validates against.
key_schemas.description: Required top-level sections for every project knowledge base.

functions.name: buildDashboard
functions.description: Orchestrates parse, model build, validation and render. Reveals the shell only after validation succeeds.

functions.name: parseXlsx
functions.description: Reads a ZIP/EOCX workbook in the browser and returns a map of sheet name to row-major grid.

functions.name: parseCodeSheet
functions.description: Reads metadata rows and the field mapping table into meta and metaTypes.

functions.name: buildFieldToCol
functions.description: Resolves each CODE_SHEET_KEYS label to a zero-based PPP column index through the Code sheet Column-X value.

functions.name: buildModel
functions.description: Builds typed packages, lookup lists, lookup metadata and the error wording map from the workbook.

functions.name: validate
functions.description: Runs V-01 to V-25 over the model and returns a report of issues with severity and workbook wording.

functions.name: renderKPIs
functions.description: Renders the six KPI cards with status classes.

functions.name: renderCat
functions.description: Renders a category chart (status, discipline, engineer, criticality, lead time) as bar or pie.

functions.name: renderPOMonthly
functions.description: Renders the monthly PO plan versus actual grouped bars with cumulative lines.

functions.name: renderLookAhead
functions.description: Lists POs planned inside the selected horizon.

data_flows.name: Workbook to packages
transformations: date serial to Date via toDate()
checks: V-19 header row points at headers
V-20 parsed count versus List End Row

data_flows.name: Packages to validation report
checks: V-21 every rule code has an error-table row

data_quality_checks: V-02 date cells parse to real dates
V-05 criticality present in the lookup
V-20 parsed row count versus List End Row
V-23 execution progress is not zero

libraries: None at runtime — the HTML is self-contained and uses only browser APIs
Node.js standard library only for test/test_pipeline.mjs (node:fs, node:vm, node:path)
infrastructure: Any modern browser; runs from file:// with no web server

known_issues.title: MR-M-0021 carried invalid FAT/ROS plan dates
known_issues.details: PPP!AD22 held 1900-01-15 (serial 15, because 15 was typed into a date cell) and PPP!AA22 held the formula =AD22-30, which gave 1899-12-15 (serial -15). toDate() rejected both, V-02 fired twice, and four harness assertions failed. The owner set AD22 to 2027-01-15 and AA22 to 2026-12-16. Harness result: 68 passed, 0 failed, errors=0. No code change.

known_issues.title: PO Number registered but had no consumer
known_issues.details: Rev 1.28 added poNo to CODE_SHEET_KEYS. Rev 1.31 makes it meaningful with V-26 (warning, data): a package with a PO Actual date must carry a PO Number. The workbook has the Code sheet row Q27:V27. Current result: 19 warnings, 0 errors; harness 71/71. PO Number is not shown in the look-ahead or overdue tables by design, because those packages have no PO issued. No CSV or KPI change.

known_issues.title: Pipeline is not importable as Node modules
known_issues.details: LEGACY RECORD, migrated verbatim to the issue log on 2026-11-01. Parsing, modelling, validation and rendering live in one inline script. Extraction into src/ modules plus build.mjs mirrors the MDL structure and enables independent pipeline tests. Checked against spec section 3.8 on 2026-10-30 (workplan section 8.7): the split is also missing deriveView (S4/S5), isExcelError with the W-FORMULA notice (section 3.8.4), and an import-based test. Owner decisions D8-D11 recorded on 2026-10-30 (workplan section 8.8): standalone page with no server and no external reference; a complete five-layer test that covers all seven panels; duplicate aggregation removed so every count is computed once in S4; an error token is absent data, excluded from all counts, and reported by W-FORMULA without blocking the render. The root Dashboard-UI-Design-Spec.md is authoritative, so P6 (tasks T8.8.18-T8.8.21) adopts the spec shell and panels; D1-D7 resolve to the spec. Plan approved 2026-10-30 with tasks T8.8.1-T8.8.21. P1 completed 2026-10-30: src/ modules and build.mjs exist, 71/71, page loads from file:// with no error. P2 deriveView, P3 isExcelError/W-FORMULA, P4 import tests and harness module paths, P6 UI conformance remain. P2 completed 2026-10-30: deriveView is the only aggregation, renderers paint only, STATE holds the view and the PO window, per-stage boundaries added, stage helpers moved to pipeline.mjs. P3 isExcelError/W-FORMULA, P4 import tests and harness module paths, P6 UI conformance remain. P3 completed 2026-10-30: isExcelError/isAbsent, blank and token cells are absent, per-column W-FORMULA. P4 import tests and harness module paths, P6 UI conformance remain. P4 completed 2026-10-30: five test layers, 212 assertions, harness Tier 3 adapter. P5 documentation and P6 UI conformance remain. I-82 (NaN in an empty filter) was found and fixed during P4.
